description: A date_range bucket aggregation — one bucket per caller-defined date range.

field.description: Required. The date column to bucket.

ranges.description: Required. The bucket ranges. Bound values may be dates or date-math expressions.

time_zone.description: Optional. UTC offset or IANA zone used to interpret the range bounds.

missing.description: Optional. Value assigned to documents missing field.

format.description: Optional. Date format applied to the bucket key in the response.
